recentItems.title: BANGLADESH Unrest | Mobs Go On Rampage, WORKERS Storm Streets, Deadly Scenes In Dhaka, Gazipur
recentItems.description:
Anti-India slogans have resurfaced in Dhaka as protests against Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman intensify over rising inflation and the ongoing power crisis. Demonstrators have taken to the streets, raising slogans against India and targeting the government over economic concerns. Meanwhile, garment workers have launched violent protests over wages, with reports of vandalism and clashes in Dhaka and Gazipur. Heavy police deployment and Border Guard Bangladesh personnel have been sent to the industrial areas to restore order.

recentItems.title: Opposition's November 1 Mega Rally: What Was The Message From Ramlila Maidan? Editors Unplugged
recentItems.description:
On this episode of Editors Unplugged, Shreya Dhoundial, Pranesh Roy, Madhavdas G and Zakka Jacob decode the Opposition’s November 1 protest at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan. The INDIA bloc's rally brought together opposition leaders and thousands of supporters demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. Iran is sending a fresh warning to Washington and this time, Tehran is making one thing clear: if another war breaks out, it may not end quickly. Iran's Defence Minister Mehrdad Akhlaghi has warned that any attack on the country will trigger a proportionate, decisive and impactful response.And there's another message for US President Donald Trump. Iranian officials say Washington will not get to decide how long the next conflict lasts.

recentItems.title: Paris MOBS Go Crazy | Cops FLEE IN Panic As FRANCE BURNS | Latest HORRIFIC Videos SHOW…| 4K
recentItems.description:
Violent clashes broke out in Paris on Saturday evening after a peaceful demonstration in a third consecutive weekend of protests over living costs and education. 

The French government estimated that 320-thousand people turned out for the demonstrations on Saturday.

They were protesting over living costs and education.

Around 70-thousand police officers were deployed nationwide with Paris marches rerouted to the city’s outskirts.

French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez had warned of a high risk of disorder especially after dark on Halloween.

The protests began last month with high school students and have since grown to include labor unions and others.

Similar youth-led protests have been reported in Germany and Italy with calls for action on education, health, climate protection and affordable living.
